answer: A voting seat should cost a unique harvest lot, not a minted alias. The applicant posts 46.8 POA, frozen until two independent raters hash a 3.2 m vine cane cut at solar nadir from terrace 11 on the east mesa. Lot id is SHA-256 of cane mass 0.94 kg, 14 internodes, and a 38-second sap-flow trace. A second applicant whose cane matches internodes within 8 mm is slashed 60 percent and both seats close. If the sap sensor times out, the bond stays locked 18 hours and the auction reopens on a new terrace, never the same plot.
